parsed_json.up_exec: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) that have indications recorded at phase 1 (max_phase_for_ind = 1). For each, return the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, indication EFO CURIE (as indication_curie), indication EFO term (as indication_label), and max_phase_for_ind.
